## New measurement covers third-party sellers (3P) responsible for 68% of Amazon Health and Beauty sales, giving brands a more complete view of category growth


**Chicago (September 28, 2026)** — NielsenIQ (NYSE: NIQ), a global leader in consumer intelligence, today announced the launch of Amazon third-party marketplace (commonly known as Amazon 3P) measurement for all Health & Beauty Care categories. By integrating Amazon third-party data into NIQ’s established retail measurement and existing data sets, including Amazon first-party data (1P), the enhanced offering delivers an expanded view of category performance and consumer purchasing behavior across online and brick-and-mortar channels.


The strategic launch addresses a critical measurement gap in one of retail’s fastest-evolving categories. Amazon is a major driver of Health & Beauty Care growth and is an indicator of emerging ingredient trends and consumer preferences. In the United States, third-party sellers on Amazon generated approximately $56 billion in Health and Beauty sales, representing 24% of tracked omnichannel category sales, according to NIQ data.* Without visibility into this activity, brands risk missing critical market signals that can shape competitive positioning, innovation strategies, and future growth.


“ *Amazon’s third-party marketplace is where many of today’s fastest-growing Health and Beauty brands gain traction, yet it has remained one of the industry’s largest measurement blind spots* ,” said **Jacqueline Flam, Managing Director, Beauty and Health at NIQ** . “ *By bringing Amazon 3P into NIQ measurement, brands can identify emerging competitors sooner, spot shifts in consumer demand earlier, and make more informed decisions around innovation, pricing, and growth* .”


**Key benefits of Amazon 3P data include:**


- Gaining a more comprehensive view of the Health & Beauty Care landscape with visibility into individual products from Amazon third-party brands
- Identifying emerging brands and market opportunities earlier, before many brands reach physical retail shelves
- Staying ahead of evolving ingredient and product trends by monitoring marketplace activity at the item level
- Better understanding the factors driving category growth


This offering, which is now live and accessible via NIQ Discover platform, marks another milestone in NIQ’s broader Full View™ strategy. Earlier this year, NIQ announced Amazon third-party measurement as a foundational component of the forthcoming NIQ Beauty Channel, which is designed to deliver a unified understanding of performance across mass, prestige, specialty, and digital commerce. Through innovations like the Beauty Channel, NIQ continues to advance its offering of the Full View™ of Beauty for clients.

## FAQs


**What is Amazon third-party measurement?**


Amazon third-party (3P) measurement provides visibility into sales from Amazon’s third-party seller marketplace, which represents nearly 68% of total Amazon Health & Beauty Care sales. It helps Health & Beauty Care brands better understand category performance, competition, and growth across the Amazon ecosystem.


**Why is Amazon third-party measurement important for Health & Beauty Care brands?**


Without visibility into Amazon’s third-party marketplace, brands could miss critical market signals that can shape positioning, innovation strategies, and future growth. Amazon third-party marketplace measurement helps provide a broader view of what is driving category growth.


**What insights can brands gain from Amazon third-party marketplace measurement?**


Brands can analyze sales, share, pricing, promotions, emerging brands, and consumer trends across Amazon’s third-party marketplace, helping them make more informed business decisions.


---


## Methodology


Analysis based on data from NIQ Marketplace Sales & Share Solution for the latest 52-week period ending August 8, 2026.
